adjudication_summary: Worker-6 re-review replaced the framework-stop decision with source-reviewed adjudication for the Pharmaceutics 2019 lipopeptide paper: DBAASP MIC rows now reconcile to XML Table 3, final activity rows use Table 2 bacterial targets and Tables 3-5 values, the supplement is exhausted as molecular-structure-only material, and aggregate CAMP/dbAMP rows remain cautionary source conflicts rather than verified primary-source facts.
summary: Source-reviewed accepted_with_cautions: primary XML/PDF/supplement/database evidence is exhausted for owner layers; preserved cautions are nonblocking aggregate database conflicts and modified-sequence representation caveats.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP linked MIC assay rows match primary XML Table 3 values and Table 2 organisms; CAMP/dbAMP aggregate rows with undefined title or mixed non-paper activity strings are preserved as source_conflict cautions.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Final activity evidence was rebuilt from source tables: 54 MIC, 108 MBFIC, and 108 MBEC records with raw μg/mL units, bacterial targets, surfaces where applicable, and XML locators.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Final mechanism record separates direct phenotypic antibiofilm assays from non-direct AMP/membrane design rationale; no unsupported direct molecular mechanism is promoted.
per_layer_decision_rationale.supplementary_material: The only local supplement is a three-page PDF of molecular structures; pdftotext and extracted supplement text show no activity/toxicity tables to add.

materials_exhausted.note: Obtainable-only source review exhausted paper-local XML/PDF/OA supplement/database surfaces relevant to worker-4/6 blockers.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Five CAMP rows and one dbAMP row in linked_experiment_records are entry-level aggregates with undefined title or mixed targets; they are not promoted to source_verified.
Merged sequence rows often store only peptide cores or multimer placeholders; Table 1 locators preserve fatty-acyl chains, C-terminal amides, and KKC disulfide dimers.
